title: Beacon channel_mask parsed but local intersection never computed (spec 02a 2a.2)
description: Requirement (R-02a-008, MUST): 'channel_mask u32 (bit 0=CH0); local intersection computed.' Classification: divergent — the field is parsed/serialized in Rust (rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:51,101,124) but no implementation computes the local intersection of the advertised mask with the regional plan / hardware-permitted channels; Python python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:84 validate_channel_mask is the plan-mask validator, a different feature; no intersection code in C or Python. Suggested placement: compute intersection at beacon ingestion before SelectChannel/NChannels derivation, feeding 2a.3.1 NChannels; vector coverage would belong in ccp_tdma.json or ccp4_regional_channel_plans.json. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-008).
